marks.cpu.p50.note: the marks as drawn over the world's models: CI's first figure, 1.78 (cb5988b), at the calibration's pace there, x1.44; since the Beacon's warnings and the reach's border (runs 533 to 543) CI measured 3.15 to 5.15, so 3.2 was held; back down with the realm's lookups cut on November 6, CI measures 1.06 at x1.21 (run 631, 0a24263), under a third of 3.2, so 1.0. Each sample was a fresh image of 3024x1964, made and filled, and with as little drawn as 27 holds, 67 companies and no blows the image came to most of the figure: 6.44 and 4.10 in runs 896 and 902 on unchanged marks. Since then each is drawn into one bitmap kept across the samples, as the game draws into a layer kept from frame to frame: the drawing alone (the fresh image told beside it as marks.image.cpu.p50). Run 914 cleared that bitmap's 24 MB within each timed sample and measured 2.45 against 1.98 for the fresh image; the clear is the compositor's work, not the marks', so it is done before the clock starts and told beside them as marks.clear.cpu.p50

marks.flat.cpu.p50.note: the flat marks of a Mac that cannot draw the world, tokens and all: CI's first figure, 4.01 (cb5988b), at the calibration's pace there, x1.44; drawn into one bitmap kept across the samples since run 902, as the marks are, cleared before each sample's clock starts since run 914 (4.74 with the clear timed)

calibration.cpu.note: plain work, none of it the game's, by thread CPU, as CI's runner does it on a quick day: the old work's 250 times the two works' measured ratio (1.41). The old work ran 277 to 505 on CI; CI's first figure for this one, 476, came with the realm's watches at 1.3 to 1.5 times their baselines, a slow day

stage.pace.cpu.note: one round of the calibration's plain work timed between the staging passes, the best of four, its baseline the calibration's 353 for six rounds: how busy the runner is while the stage is timed, paces only the stage's figures

stage.cpu.p50.note: the world's models staged for a frame on the main thread: CI's first figure, 2.36 (cb5988b), at the calibration's pace there, x1.44; raised to 4.0 for fields of battle drawn as throngs (a figure for every 500 troops standing, up to 48 a company) in the late game the stage times, where battles now fight on through every watch (CI 566: 4.38 at x1.18); lowered to 2.2 once each model made in Blender is posed from its own joints alone and a matrix product is worked lane by lane, the same floats in far less time unoptimised (CI 623 on 424ef79: 5.67 at x1.16; CI 624 on c20e9f2, CI's first figure since: 2.43 at x1.21)

stage.cpu.p95.note: the world's models staged for a frame on the main thread: CI's first figure, 2.50 (cb5988b), at the calibration's pace there, x1.44; raised to 4.2 with the throngs of fields of battle (CI 566: 4.51 at x1.18); lowered to 2.3 with the poses' cost cut (CI 623: 5.91 at x1.16; CI 624: 2.44 at x1.21)
